Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ajay - 31 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Hema - 26 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Sonali - 63 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ajay stands by the road. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ajay rides his motorbike to the market.]

Ajay: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ajay starts his scooter and rides off.]

Ajay: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Ajay stands on the road. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "So, here we are!"

[Ajay starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Ajay: "Show me too!"

[Ajay is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Hema: "That was such a fun day!"
